That’s why Labor is making commonsense decisions to save the Budget $2 billion while delivering projects Victoria needs.
$2 billion in savings on the Suburban Rail Loop
The Suburban Rail Loop is an important project for Victoria.
Labor is making every dollar count while building it.
The Government has identified around $1 billion in immediate savings by reducing spending on unnecessary additions to the project’s scope.
This means the total estimated investment in SRL is now $33.3 billion.
We will also commission an independent, technical review to target a further $1 billion in savings.

The Carroll government has committed to building the Suburban Rail Loop, but has promised to slash $1 billion from its budget by removing additions such as car parking at stations and pedestrian bridges.
It has also promised to commission an independent review to claw back another $1 billion in savings to bring the total estimated cost of the project to $32.3 billion.
